content.title: Act alone and become an enemy｜The action material condenses into an opponent and then collides
content.summary: First, the complete movements of a single subject are used to establish distinguishable moves and material signatures, and then the environmental materials are accumulated and condensed into an independent opponent; in the middle and later stages, a space jump is used to draw the two parties into a head-on confrontation, and finally a second energy material is introduced to complete the collision and return to the final readable state of the subject.

quick_start.input_format: Single target moves and material signatures + Environmental materials condensed into independent opponents + Space jump to establish confrontation + Second energy material collision + Main body readable final state
quick_start.recommended_input: At dawn in the original glass desert, an airflow engineer stands next to the suspended kiln bridge and completes a set of spiral movements with a brass resonance ring. The transparent pressure refraction leaves a clear trace along the path; the mass condenses into a transparent four-legged crystal opponent, approaching the suspension bridge along one end; the engineer enters from the other end, and the routes, bridge decks and distances of both sides are jointly readable; the fragments and cobalt blue light recede, and the engineer lands on the far platform, holding the resonance ring in a readable direction from the opening, and stabilizing the last transparent pressure profile
required_anchors: Establish one subject's complete movement signature and its material trace before an opponent appears.
Accumulate the same environmental material around the subject before it gains agency.
Reserve a contrasting second material for one late clash peak.
After the collision, restore one readable subject state with the signature action or tool still identifiable.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First, the complete movements of a single subject are used to establish distinguishable moves and material signatures, and then the environmental materials are accumulated and condensed into an independent opponent; in the middle and later stages, a space jump is used to draw the two parties into a head-on confrontation, and finally a second energy material is introduced to complete the collision and return to the final readable state of the subject.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Begin with one subject performing a complete, readable form that establishes both a movement signature and a material trace. Let environmental residue from that performance accumulate before it condenses into an independent adversary; the opponent must visibly originate from the established material family. Use one spatial crossing to bring both agents into a shared confrontation, introduce a contrasting second material only at the late peak, and close on a readable subject state after the material collision.

invariants.rule: Establish one subject's complete movement signature and its material trace before an opponent appears.
invariants.purpose: Creates the action vocabulary and origin material.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate enemy gives the material no causal history.

invariants.rule: Accumulate the same environmental material around the subject before it gains agency.
invariants.purpose: Makes the adversary an outcome of the established field.
invariants.ablation_failure: A random arriving character is only an unrelated antagonist.

invariants.rule: Condense the material into an independent opponent and bring both agents onto one readable spatial route.
invariants.purpose: Converts solo proof into a causal confrontation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Abstract weather without an opponent cannot test the movement signature.

invariants.rule: Reserve a contrasting second material for one late clash peak.
invariants.ablation_failure: Using both materials from the start flattens the hierarchy.

invariants.rule: After the collision, restore one readable subject state with the signature action or tool still identifiable.
invariants.purpose: Closes the arc on agency rather than pure spectacle.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending inside debris leaves the causal winner and retained skill unclear.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source Chinese ink-wash mountains and bamboo
the source tiger and serpentine ink adversaries
the source curved sword and exact martial choreography
the source black-ink and gold-energy battle order plus Hailuo/MiniMax watermarks

instantiations.concept: In an original glass desert, a lone airflow engineer uses a resonant ring to draw one clear spiral pressure pattern. Sand-laden wind accumulates and crystallizes into a four-legged glass adversary; both cross one suspended kiln bridge, where a late cobalt molten stream meets the clear pressure field before the engineer returns to a stable ring-control stance.

instantiations.concept: In a tactile paper observatory, a small clockwork weather vane performs three directional turns that leave folded ribbon wakes. The ribbons gather into an autonomous storm puppet, both travel across a rotating paper orrery, and only at the peak does a silver foil current collide with the matte storm before the vane locks into its original north-pointing posture.
